name: sheet

files.content:
{#if ctx.open}
{@render ctx.content?.()} {#if closeButton} {/if}
{/if} {@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { CloseProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, trigger, variant = "outline", size, rounded, class: className }: CloseProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const triggerProps = { onclick: () => (ctx.open = false) };
</script>

<!-- Render the custom close trigger when given, otherwise a default outline button. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} {size} {rounded} class={className} {...triggerProps}>{@render children?.()}</Button>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ContentProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children }: ContentProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Hand the content to the root, which renders it inside the sheet panel.
	ctx.content = children;
</script>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { FooterProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: FooterProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Footer for actions, pinned to the end of the panel. -->
<footer class={["sheetFooter", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</footer>

<style>
	/* Base footer; the auto margin pushes it to the end of the panel instead of adding space */
	.sheetFooter {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
		margin-top: auto;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { HeaderProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: HeaderProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Header with the title and description. -->
<header class={["sheetHeader", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</header>

<style>
	/* Base header */
	.sheetHeader {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: var(--spacing-xs);
	}
</style>
{@render children()}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { TriggerProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, trigger, variant = "default", size, rounded, class: className }: TriggerProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const triggerProps = { onclick: () => (ctx.open = true) };
</script>

<!-- Render the custom trigger when given, otherwise a default button. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} {size} {rounded} class={className} {...triggerProps}>{@render children?.()}</Button>
{/if}
